Dr. Bhogaraju Pattabhi Sitaramaiah, an eminent freedom fighter, economist and Congress leader, founded Andhra Bank on 20 November 1923 at Machilipatnam. The bank was established with the objective of encouraging banking habits among Indians and promoting indigenous enterprise during the freedom movement. It became one of the leading commercial banks in South India and played an important role in supporting trade, agriculture and small industries. Besides founding Andhra Bank, Pattabhi Sitaramaiah was a distinguished historian and author of History of the Indian National Congress. He later served as the President of the Indian National Congress (1948–49) and also as the Governor of Madhya Pradesh.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
